_source: PLAN.md:1086-1097 (Rev 2 mandatory FP traps) + PLAN.md:1082-1084 triage context

traps.trap: mobilepay is a substring of SquareMobilePaymentsSDK
traps.rule: Bare `mobilepay` gives a guaranteed double hit on Square. Anchor required: \bMobilePay\b|mobilepay://|MobilePaySDK|mobilepay\.dk. A hit that also appears in frameworks_payment_hits.txt as part of SquareMobilePaymentsSDK -> false_positive (duplicate); do not file twice.

Open-banking Tink = pod TinkLink (TinkLink.xcframework, Tink.openUrl, link.tink.com). A bare Tink/TinkKit/com.google.crypto.tink hit WITHOUT the TinkLink cluster -> false_positive (Google crypto library, extremely common transitive dep). Context check mandatory.

traps.trap: sepa is a substring of separate/separator/separated
traps.rule: Only sepa\b|sepa[- ]?transfer. Hits on separate/separator/separated -> false_positive.

traps.trap: swish is an ordinary English word
traps.rule: Sound-effect strings, animations. Only swish://|getswish|SwishSDK|\bSwish\b IN a payment context (+-20 lines: pay/checkout/bank/amount/SEK). Otherwise false_positive.
Only Frames\.framework|Checkout\.framework|CheckoutEventLoggerKit|CheckoutAPIClient|api\.checkout\.com|cko-. Hits on CGRect/frames:/UI animations -> false_positive.

traps.trap: zoOm/zoom (FaceTec) -- bare zoom catches Zoom SDK and pinch animations
identity (webview_url/localization) -- Microsoft identity platform / Sign in with Apple
Vendored deps of iProov (Starscream, GPUImage2, SwiftProtobuf, TrustKit)
traps.rule: General-purpose WebSocket/crypto libraries do NOT prove iProov -> false_positive without the IProov cluster.

traps.trap: Ad networks (AdMob GAD*, AppLovin AL*, ironSource/LevelPlay IS*, FAN FBAd*) are the FP source for StoreKit/WebView strings
traps.rule: SKStoreProductViewController, itunes strings inside ad SDKs are not violations.

traps.trap: logEvent/\bAdjust\b/ALSdk/IS* are short or generic names
traps.rule: Accept only together with a vendor-specific marker (af_purchase/AFEventPurchase, ADJEvent/app.adjust.com, AppLovinSDK, IronSourceSDK).

traps.trap: Analytics purchase tracking vs payment processing (R17)
traps.rule: Tracks purchases = logEvent/transaction:andReceipt:/setRevenue/sk_purchase/BranchEvent.PURCHASE near attribution hosts (onelink.me, app.adjust.com, api2.branch.io, sdk-api-v1.singular.net, tenjin-skan.com), WITHOUT own payment UI classes and WITHOUT card/3DS crypto -> analytics (medium/low, record it). Processes payments = PaymentForm/*CardForm*/*Tokeniz*/ThreeDsProcessor/STPCardValidator + provider host -> payment SDK (CRITICAL). Practical check: Phase 4.4b payment_ui_classes.txt.

traps.trap: mitid inside commitID/_commitID (observed in the reference audit)
traps.rule: Bare `mitid` pattern without word boundary matches commitID -> false_positive unless an anchored Nordic cluster is present.

traps.trap: QN[A-Z][A-Za-z]+ matches the System.Xml Qn* BCL family in Mono/.NET runtimes
traps.rule: QnXmlNs/QnName/QnDtDt etc. inside Mono BCL -> not Qonversion -> false_positive.

escalation_triggers: nordic_payment hits (all -- anchors reduce but do not exclude FP)
signature pack lines with # lead status
suppression_scope_rule: analytics_purchase patterns may be suppressed ONLY per binary+SDK (e.g. AppsFlyerLib.framework:af_purchase), never globally: the same af_purchase in the main binary near payment classes is a violation (PLAN.md:1100).
